findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: nexus_npm_package_ws_has_241560546_weekly_down_open_websocket_session, nexus_npm_package_ws_has_241560546_weekly_down_drain_ws_frame_buffer · Public sink: nexus_npm_package_ws_has_241560546_weekly_down_send_typed_ws_frame.
findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
